# ArgoCD GitOps Continuous Delivery Mesh

Declarative GitOps deployment pipeline managing multi-environment Kubernetes applications on AWS EKS using ArgoCD, Helm, and GitHub Actions.

## Architecture Overview
```
[Code Push] -> [GitHub Actions Build & Scan] -> [Update GitOps Repo]
                                                      |
                                                      v
                                           [ArgoCD Sync Controller]
                                                      |
                                             +--------+--------+
                                             |                 |
                                         [EKS Dev]         [EKS Prod]
```

## Tech Stack
- ArgoCD 2.10+
- Kubernetes / AWS EKS
- Helm 3
- GitHub Actions
- Trivy (Container security scan)

## Key Features
- Declarative application state via Git repository as single source of truth
- Automated drift detection with self-healing reconciliation
- Slack alert dispatch on deployment status change
- Strict RBAC with least-privilege service accounts

# Progressive Delivery on Kubernetes — Flagger & Istio Canary

Zero-downtime, metric-driven automated canary deployments for mission-critical microservices.

## Canary Analysis Flow
1. New version detected by Flagger
2. Shift 5% traffic to canary pod
3. Query Prometheus for 99th percentile latency and HTTP 5xx error rate
4. If metrics pass, step up to 25%, 50%, 100%
5. If failure threshold exceeded, immediately rollback to primary baseline
